mapper.select: SELECT dvp.version_id AS versionId, COALESCE(dvp.version, fv.version, 'UNKNOWN') AS version, COALESCE(dvp.internal_version, fv.internal_version) AS internalVersion, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS deviceCount FROM devices d LEFT JOIN device_version_parts dvp ON dvp.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN firmware_versions fv ON fv.id = dvp.version_id AND fv.deleted = 0 WHERE d.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY dvp.version_id, COALESCE(dvp.version, fv.version, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(dvp.internal_version, fv.internal_version) ORDER BY deviceCount DESC, (versionId IS NULL) ASC, versionId ASC

WITH policy AS ( SELECT id, product_id, target_mode, target_version_id, affected_total FROM upgrade_policies WHERE id = #{policyId} AND deleted = 0 ), matched_devices AS ( SELECT d.id FROM devices d JOIN policy p ON p.product_id = d.product_id WHERE p.target_mode = 'ALL'
UNION
SELECT d.id FROM devices d JOIN policy p ON p.id = #{policyId} JOIN upgrade_policy_target_devices uptd ON uptd.policy_id = p.id AND uptd.imei = d.imei WHERE p.target_mode = 'DEVICE_IDS'
UNION
SELECT d.id FROM devices d JOIN policy p ON p.id = #{policyId} JOIN upgrade_policy_target_batches uptb ON uptb.policy_id = p.id AND uptb.batch_id = d.import_batch_id WHERE p.target_mode = 'DEVICE_BATCHES'
UNION
SELECT dt.device_id AS id FROM policy p JOIN upgrade_policy_target_tags uptt ON uptt.policy_id = p.id JOIN device_tags dt ON dt.tag_key = uptt.tag_key AND dt.tag_value = uptt.tag_value WHERE p.target_mode = 'DEVICE_TAGS' GROUP BY dt.device_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(uptt.tag_key, ':', uptt.tag_value)) = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upgrade_policy_target_tags WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} ) ) SELECT p.affected_total AS affectedTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dvp.version_id = p.target_version_id THEN md.id END) AS upgradedTotal FROM policy p LEFT JOIN matched_devices md ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN device_version_parts dvp ON dvp.device_id = md.id AND dvp.is_primary = 1 GROUP BY p.affected_total

UNION

UNION

UNION
